script: It's five o'clock. At the field, a coach lays out the last cone and calls the players in. Across town, a girl in cleats checks her phone. Her dad's text says, "Still at work. I get out at five-thirty." She's read the tryout post three times. One field. One start time. No number to call if she can't get there. Tomorrow, the coach will sit down with a clipboard and ask, "Who did we miss?" Everyone on that sheet got a chance to play. Her name never made it onto the page.
